prompts.down: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite sheet for the attached original character reference: abyss twin-blade demon god, black obsidian armor, thin gold trim, glowing orange lava seams, horned helmet, TWO large swept angular blade wings on back, FOUR arms holding four fiery curved swords, two armored legs. Keep reference identity and silhouette. Pixel-art styled high-detail dark fantasy 2.5D isometric RPG sprite, viewed slightly from above. This sheet ONLY FRONT facing viewer/down direction, never turn sideways. EXACTLY twelve separate full-body poses in an evenly spaced 4-column by 3-row contact sheet. Row1: four walking cycle poses, alternating left and right leg strides with visible different leg motion. Row2: four coordinated four-blade melee attack stages: windup, slash across, impact with compact fire arc, recovery; body twist but same front orientation. Row3: col1 cast charge, col2 cast release, col3 recoil hit, col4 recover hit. Every character same armor, FOUR arms, same size; feet visible. Large transparent gutters around each sprite, no touching neighboring cells. Fit full wings, swords and boots inside each cell with 12 percent margin. Fixed camera/scale, character center and feet aligned. No ground, no shadow, no floor circle, no pedestal, no scenery. Actual transparent alpha background. NO title, letters, numbers, frames or grid lines. Landscape sheet 4:3, ideally 1536 by1152.
